name: unified-band
description: Ponytail mode and skills plus one band above the prompt: controls, session info, cost, tests, limits, model router and project completion.

progressFile.title: Progress file
progressFile.description: Markdown checklist at the repo root. Project Completion is its checked boxes over all boxes. The card is hidden when the file is missing.

ledger.title: Task board
ledger.description: After every turn, write this task's row to ~/.config/ponytail/band/<project>.csv for the board.

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: Optional: an https address that gets this task's row as JSON after every turn. Empty: nothing leaves this machine.

webhookToken.title: Webhook token
webhookToken.description: Optional: sent to the webhook as a Bearer token.

sendNames.title: Send task names
sendNames.description: Send each task's name to the webhook. Off: the board shows the task without a name.
